## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: Spike report exists at plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md with pinned version + exit-code mapping
- dd-2: Cold-start and warm-cache latency measurements
- dd-3: Diff-touched-line scoping behavior documented
- dd-4: Spike report committed before enforcement stories begin

## Implementation
1. Run npx --yes @google/design.md@latest --version to determine the latest available version
2. Test exit codes: run the CLI against valid and invalid DESIGN.md files, record which exit codes map to pass/fail/warning
3. Measure cold-start latency (first npx invocation) and warm-cache (second invocation)
4. Test diff-touched-line scoping under Prettier auto-formatting
5. Write findings to plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md
6. Select and document the pinned version

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Spike report exists — Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md
- [ ] Report contains pinned version — Verify: grep -q 'pinned.*version\|version.*pin' plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md
- [ ] Report contains exit-code mapping — Verify: grep -qi 'exit.code' plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md
- [ ] Report contains latency measurements — Verify: grep -qi 'latency\|cold.start\|warm.cache' plugins/dso/docs/spikes/design-md-cli-validation.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
